control_plane_policy: Studio is a ChatGPT host adapter only; the pinned official skills/ppt-master Harness owns PPT routing, workflow, gates, templates, images, motion, recovery semantics and QA.
project_router_policy: Project Instructions contain only the minimal PPT-to-Studio routing contract and point to studio/host/chatgpt/ENTRYPOINT.md.
lazy_load_policy: Load only the current host entry/runtime authority and explicitly triggered supporting files; do not preload duplicate Studio workflow policy.
runtime_bundle_policy: commit-bound whitelist containing official skills/ppt-master plus the minimal ChatGPT host adapters required for bootstrap, pinning, portable recovery, Interactive Code Block mini-app preview, and optional static confirmation fallback
human_confirmation_fallback_policy: confirmation-surface failure may change transport but never decision ownership; unless explicitly delegated, chat fallback must present the unresolved official Gate items and wait for explicit user confirmation or revision before persistence and continuation
mini_app_transport_policy: when ChatGPT exposes supported HTML/React code-block Preview, a host adapter may render the active official confirmation data as a self-contained mini app; the adapter must not redefine the official Gate schema and must not assume an undocumented automatic callback from Preview to the assistant
